request.style: English, female solo, ethereal and warm, harp, uilleann pipes, bodhran, acoustic guitar, soft strings, reverent and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Gentiles sought no law of works
But found the grace they did not seek
Israel pressed to reach the goal
Yet fell short of what they took

[Verse]
They chased a law by human hands
But missed the faith that sets them free
Stumbled on the stone they saw
And tumbled in their own decree

[Chorus]
See I lay in Zion a stone
A rock that makes them fall and break
But the one who believes in him
Shall not be put to shame

[Verse]
Righteousness by faith is found
For those who do not chase the prize
The law was sought by works alone
And left the seeker blind to eyes

[Chorus]
See I lay in Zion a stone
A rock that makes them fall and break
But the one who believes in him
Shall not be put to shame

[Bridge]
Not by your hands but by his grace
The stumbling block becomes the way
Believe in him and stand secure
Your faith will never fade away

[Chorus]
See I lay in Zion a stone
A rock that makes them fall and break
But the one who believes in him
Shall not be put to shame

[Outro]
Believe in him and not be shamed
Your faith remains forever true
